datasheets.title: GHz NOISE SUPPRESSION CHIP FERRITE BEAD for Consumer equipment & Industrial equipment BLM18H□□□□SN1□ REFERENCE SPECIFICATION
datasheets.supersedes_note: murata.com/products/productdata ENFA0004.pdf mirrors were rev V; PIM serves rev W.

series.EG: For general use; low DC resistance and large rated current for noise suppression of driver circuits; thin type (TN1, t=0.5mm) for low-profile equipment.
series.HE: For DC power line; resistance grows at lower frequency, effective at suppressing ringing (Murata: for optical pickup modules).
series.HG: For general use; high impedance at 1GHz, effective over a wide range (several MHz to several GHz); ~3x A/B-type impedance at 1GHz.
series.HD: For high speed signal line; sharper roll-off after cut-off frequency; ~3x A/B-type impedance at 1GHz.
series.HB: For high speed signal line; sharper roll-off after cut-off frequency.
series.HK: For digital interface; resistance grows at lower frequency, effective at suppressing ringing.

notes: Two reference specs cover the BLM18 GHz-noise family for consumer/industrial use: ENFA0021 (BLM18EG, rev JENF243A_0021U-01) and ENFA0004 (BLM18H_SN: HE/HG/HD/HB/HK, rev JENF243A_0004W-01). Both are the current files linked from Murata's PIM product pages as of 2026-10-02.
Out of scope: automotive BLM18H□□□□SH1□ (AEC-Q200) is a separate spec, QNFA9104 (JENF243A_9104K-01); not included.

Impedance at 100MHz is printed as nominal±25% (the part-number code is the 'typical value at 100MHz'); no separate 100MHz typical is given, so impedance_typ_ohm is null. The 1GHz column is in impedance_ghz: EG/HE/HG/HD give min. and typ.; HB/HK give a ±40% tolerance spec.

Last letter of the part number is the packaging code. The specs define only D (taping; 180mm paper tape, 4000 pcs/reel). Murata PIM lists B = bulk (bag, 1000 pcs), D = 180mm paper tape (4000), J = 330mm paper tape (10000) for every part here; only D variants are cataloged.
dcr_max_ohm is the 'Initial values' DCR max; the 'Values after testing' max is recorded in each part's notes.
Operating and storage temperature both -55°C to +125°C for both specs.
Murata PIM API values (impedance, rated current at 85/125°C, DCR) were cross-checked against the PDF tables and agree for all 24 parts.
Lifecycle: all 24 parts 'In Production' per Murata PIM (2026-10-02); Digi-Key product pages returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch, so distributor status was not independently confirmed.
